cases.name: Mollie Ann Snyder
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She graduated from Edcouch Elsa High school in 1956. Mollie continued her education at Hermann Hospital and achieved her dream of becoming a Certified Physical Therapist in 1962.

In 1965 Mollie married Robert (Bob) Haley in San Antonio where Bob was a pilot with the military. While deployed in Stuttgart, Germany Juanita Ruth was born in 1966 to the happy couple. Upon completion of military service, Bob and Mollie moved back to the Rio Grande Valley. Soon thereafter, McAllen General Hospital hired Mollie to become their first Physical Therapist. In 1971 Mollie became a young widow as Bob died in a tragic accident so she did her best to raise Juanita as she continued to work at M.G.H.

Mollie found new love as she married a recent widower in Calvin Neil Snyder in 1976. It was if God had brought them together and in fact there were several preachers and preachers kids praying for God's will for them. When Mollie and Calvin married their family grew as Calvin brought Sterling and Debra Diane into the family. During Calvin's and Mollie's time together they worshiped and grew in the Lord. They supported each other during bouts with cancer and heart disease and through it all their faith never faltered. Finally, in 2013 after 51 years of Physical Therapy work Mollie retired. In retirement they enjoyed another year together as they worshiped, gardened, and hosted meals for families and friends. In 2014, after 38 years of marriage Calvin went home to be with the Lord. Now, Mollie and Calvin are celebrating in Heaven together."
cases.narrative:
On 9/1/2021, her body was found wrapped in a blanket and other bed linens on a downgrade leading to a wash in Box Canyon off Whitehouse Canyon Road near the Santa Rita Experimental Range. A short drone flight was conducted just before 1 p.m. Sept. 1, before bad weather moved in, that captured images of the roadway, ravine and creek near where the body was found, overall photos of the body, and the “drag marks and the path the body took down to the final location,” which was about 31 feet from the edge of the road. According to the report, the body “appeared to have been pushed off the road and it rolled until it got caught on a small tree just a few feet from the wash.” As they peeled back layers of linen, detectives noted it appeared as if the body were “placed on top of a bed that was made, and then wrapped around the linen” with duct tape and a sort of filament tape wrapping it together. The first layer of linen appeared to be a bed comforter, or decorative blanket, followed by two sheets (one fitted), and a mattress cover, according to the report. Detectives noted that the victim’s hands and ankles were bound with a cloth-like material, and a green bungee cord was wrapped around her neck. She had trauma to her face and left arm, and a large concentration of what appeared to be blood around her head, according to the report. Detectives also collected several items found with the body, which included a makeup bag, a wallet with cards and a Social Security card for Mollie Snyder, clothing, money and pillows.
